from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """A single paper document with its title and the list of other provided papers it references."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being processed")
    referenced_paper_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers found in this paper's reference list")
    reference_context: str | None = Field(description="Brief context or section where the reference is mentioned, e.g. 'References', 'Related Work'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
